summary: This week brought major earnings from mega-cap tech alongside key economic growth and inflation data. PCE inflation hit 3.5% year-over-year in March, a near three-year high, driven largely by a surge in gas prices, keeping the Fed on hold and pressuring bonds. Separately, developments in Iran and the Strait of Hormuz continue to roil markets, with news from the region and oil price movements acting as a primary driver of market trends.
tweet: PCE inflation at a near three-year high and Iran-Strait of Hormuz tensions are running the tape — stocks shrugging it off, bonds and gold less so.
